hypothesis: Submission12 preserved three finishes and improved every lap after reducing redundant compound braking, but the active controller still applies the supplemental curve-brake envelope for four detector-miss frames after a compound obstacle disappears. Removing only that supplement during miss1--4, while retaining target30 and the inherited base speed brake, should reduce post-pass speed loss without weakening any current-visible-obstacle approach or high-speed base braking.

scope.single_factor: During compound detector-miss latch frames1--4 only, return the inherited base brake instead of taking max(base brake, the supplemental compound curve-brake envelope).

requirements: the active pace-latched target is exactly30
the active command target is exactly30
the frame began with a nonzero obstacle-side latch
the obstacle side remains nonzero after detector processing
the detector miss count is in1--4
the inherited nonstraight overspeed branch is active above target plus0.5
eligibility_gate.formula: emitted_candidate_brake = min(inherited_base_brake, nextafter(float32(MAX_BRAKE),0)); gas remains zero because the inherited overspeed branch is active

frozen: all current-visible obstacles, including current compound obstacles at every distance and speed
compound target30, straight-obstacle targets47/40 and every target-selection formula
the inherited base speed brake and final float32 maximum-brake clamp
obstacle detector, obstacle side, four-frame miss latch and fifth-frame clearing behavior
all steering, road perception, post-obstacle curve retention, gas and recovery logic
settled clear-straight double throttle and every noncompound state
model.pt and every non-bare inference route
official environment, reward, termination, frame skip and action contract
rejected_alternatives: Do not raise compound target30: prior extreme-seed failures lost the road around speed29--30, and rendered videos do not expose internal clearance or detector state.
Do not remove or weaken the inherited base brake: it is the remaining closed-loop target30 safety envelope and dominates at speed45 or above.
Do not remove the supplement while an obstacle is currently visible: submission11 contained a rendered23.8-pixel center-distance pass and submission12 provides no policy-camera clearance proof.
Do not shorten the obstacle-side latch or change steering in this experiment because detector flicker and post-obstacle curve retention are separate safety factors.
static_acceptance: Current compound obstacles at all registered speed boundaries remain action- and state-exact to control.
Only brake differs on compound miss frames1--4 above target plus0.5; target, gas, steering and shared inherited state remain exact.
Every changed candidate brake equals the inherited emitted base-brake envelope, never exceeds control, remains finite/in bounds and never overlaps positive gas.
Both turn directions, sweep immediately below/at6 and obstacle rows32/50 receive directed coverage.
The target-plus0.5, base-brake onset, supplemental/base crossover and final base-saturation boundaries receive directed coverage.

The fifth clearing frame, sixth released frame, current compound reacquisition, noncompound reacquisition, straight latch, clear curve/straight, invalid input, road loss and reset remain control-exact.
Randomized sequence differential coverage proves every difference is registered and brake-only.
Affected controller, inference, local-contract and submission suites pass.
An isolated package passes exact-file import, reset, finite-action, bounds and latency smoke without modifying root submission.zip.
rollback: Any action or shared-state difference outside the registered brake component and compound miss1--4 gate.
Any current-visible-obstacle, target, gas, steering, detector, latch-duration, reset, invalid-input, recovery, dependency, packaging, bounds, NaN or latency regression.
Any candidate brake below the inherited emitted base-brake envelope or above the control brake.

future_environment_gate.reason: SOTA.md, RESULTS.md, COMPETITION_INFO.md, RESTRICTIONs.md and report.pdf are absent.
future_environment_gate.design_after_restoration: Freeze paired control and candidate package hashes, then run fresh gentle and compound-hairpin obstacle seeds. Rank valid finish first, then progress/collision/crash/off-track/minimum clearance and only then paired lap and obstacle-sector time.
future_environment_gate.safety_rollback: Reject on any new DNF, lower finish count, added collision/crash/off-track, materially lower minimum clearance or operational failure.
future_environment_gate.pace_gate: Only after safety non-regression, require lower paired lap or post-obstacle sector time.

evidence_limits: Submission12 videos are user-attributed and lack action/speed/source/package telemetry, so they cannot bind the candidate or identify exact miss-latch frames.

A detector miss can be a transient false negative before the vehicle has fully cleared the obstacle; retaining target30, obstacle-side steering and base braking mitigates but does not eliminate this risk.
Same-input static tests cannot prove future closed-loop observations, trajectory clearance, completion or lap time.
No environment cell, training run, official submission or SOTA comparison is authorized by this protocol.
